comparisons.reason: Different constructs and row functions. Item 0 is an all-comments measure: it returns 1 only if every comment is solely abstract normative, and 0 if any comment has concrete details or non-normative argumentation. Item 1 is an any-comment measure: it returns 1 if at least one comment uses a specific concrete example. They are not simple inversions. Item 0 also returns 0 for non-normative but abstract argumentation, such as factual or logical claims, which item 1 would not count as a concrete example. The empty-list rules also differ: item 0 returns null and item 1 returns 0.
